key_findings: Nav1.7 knockout mice have essentially normal nociceptor soma excitability but reduced opioid-dependent glutamate release from central terminals in spinal cord.
Naloxone restores glutamate release and spinal WDR neuron firing in Nav1.7 KO mice.
